title: רבי חוצפית המתורגמן

paragraphs: Rabbi Chutzpit, the interpreter of Rabban Gamliel of Yavneh. He is mentioned in the Mishnah at the end of Sheviit (chapter 10, mishnah 6), Berakhot 27b, near the end, and Bekhorot 36a: “They said to R. Chutzpit the interpreter: stop, etc.” Tosafot writes that he was one of the ten martyrs killed by the government. Their intention is this: Elisha Acher saw a tongue dragged by a pig and said, “A mouth that produces pearls!”—meaning that he had been an interpreter. How could it be that he was not buried? Chullin 142. They therefore wrote that he was one of the ten martyrs. It requires investigation why Tosafot did not write this in Berakhot. He was the equal of Yonatan ben Uzziel and taught 170 interpretations of Torat Kohanim. He was a reincarnation of Yehoyakim; see R. Perida above. Joseph brought an evil report and was reincarnated in him: Peliah, and Yalkut Reuveni, portion Vayeshev. See above, year 2216.
